verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, including a government incorporation portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a robots.txt on justica.gov.pt or eportugal.gov.pt. The only probe checked a 404 on the Empresa Online entry URL, which says nothing about crawl rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
